note: string-level checks; none of them proves that a translation is correct (see the module docstring)

target_conventions: space: 1 234,5 (no-break / thin / narrow no-break space only)
numbers.unit_note: symbols only; unit WORDS (years, days, percent, dollars) are translated and therefore not checked
numbers.any_numeric_error_strict: recall < 1 or precision < 1 on the multiset of numerals
numbers.any_numeric_error_lenient: as strict, ignoring integers <= small_int_max (they may be spelled out) on both sides

statute_ref.note: reference locator after the keyword is checked (Section 5(1)(a), Article 12); the keyword itself is translated

citation_author_year.note: (Smith et al., 2019): copied for Latin-script targets

url.note: the documents of the split contain none (removed); kept for other uses of the metric

chem_gene.note: CO2, H2O, CD4, IL-6, COVID-19, SARS-CoV, Ca2+

latin_name.note: binomials (heuristic: capitalised genus + Latin-looking epithet): Plasmodium falciparum, E. coli; sentence-initial false positives are possible

acronym.note: all-caps tokens of 2-8 characters (WHO, DNA, BRCA1, USD); roman numerals included

protected.latin_only_note: classes marked latin_only are scored only when >= 80% of the letters of the translation are Latin/Greek (names are transliterated in other scripts)

formulas.compared_on: content without delimiters and white space
formulas.exact_share: multiset overlap / number of source spans
formulas.order: longest common subsequence of the span sequence / number of source spans; edit distance of the sequence

term_consistency.heuristic: word-alignment-free: for each English term (1-2 content words, >= 3 occurrences in sentences/beads), the candidate rendering is a target word (5-character prefix, for inflection) whose contrast (share of the term's beads containing it minus share of the other beads containing it) is >= min_contrast; the one covering most of the term's beads is the modal rendering; consistency = share of the term's beads that contain it. Undetermined terms (contrast < min_contrast) are not counted. The same statistic is computed on the reference as a baseline.

modality.note: a FLAG LIST for human audit, not a score: a bead is flagged when the source bead has a cue, and the learned target equivalent(s) of the cue (learned from the sentence-aligned reference) occur in the reference bead but not in the translation bead, or (no lexicon) the translation bead is much shorter than the reference bead
